sisi.depan: A towering, sharp-edged portal of solid black crystal stands at the far end of the glossy floor, its opening filled with a shimmering, silent energy field.
sisi.kanan: The right wall is a sheer surface of dark blue crystal from which emerge several tall, thin, hexagonal columns that pulse with faint internal light.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint is a wide, unadorned archway cut directly into the crystal, leading into a darker corridor from which the camera observes the hall.
sisi.kiri: The left wall is broken by a series of large, inset, polished black crystal facets that reflect the hall with distorted depth and clarity.

tengah: A large, multi-faceted black crystal hovers motionless in the middle of the hall, slowly rotating and facing towards the monolithic portal.
atas: The vaulted ceiling is a continuous expanse of polished dark blue crystal, reflecting the geometric patterns of bright lines glowing beneath the floor in a complex, distorted web.
